Notes

Consent chrome should be absent on both sides, which makes it a hide rather than a mask. Content that exists on both sides but drifts is a different problem and belongs in a mask, because hiding it would reflow the page around the gap it leaves.

Hidden rather than removed, too. Removing a banner after its own script has run tends to wedge the renderer, and a screenshot that never returns is worse than one that is wrong.
